messages:
emma: quick FYI - discovered a bundler/entry-interop quirk that causes our SDK retry to strip auth headers in edge bundles built with Vite/Rollup. repro is small and deterministic.

kai: thanks for flagging. is this specific to ESM output or the edge shim?

emma: both. short story: when the package export resolves to the ESM entry, some bundlers inline a tiny helper that ends up using `new Request(req)` to clone requests instead of calling `req.clone()`. In our edge shim that drops certain header iterators so Authorization disappears on retry. Node CJS bundles call `req.clone()` and are fine.

nina: can you paste the minimal repro steps?

emma: sure:
1) git clone https://example/repro-edge-auth
2) npm ci
3) npm run build:vite-edge (produces dist/esm)
4) npm run serve:edge (local edge runtime shim)
5) curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN123" http://localhost:8787/api/proxy

expected: first request -> 200 proxied. actual: first request -> 200, SDK initiates a retry and retry returns 403 because Authorization header missing.

emma: repro package.json exports snippet:
```json
{"name":"repro-edge-auth","type":"module","exports":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","default":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}}
```

emma: built ESM helper in dist/esm/edge-runtime.js (vite build) shows:
```js
function buildRetry(req){
  // bundler-inlined helper (not our original source)
  const r = new Request(req.url, req); // ends up without headers in some edge shims
  return fetch(r);
}
```

emma: the CJS build keeps clone():
```js
function buildRetry(req){
  const r = req.clone();
  return fetch(r);
}
```

kai: hmm. could be Rollup interop transform or a polyfill that changes what `req` looks like at runtime. any idea which plugin triggers it?

emma: local bisect pointed at a combination of `@rollup/plugin-commonjs` + a terser tree-shake step that removed a small Request polyfill we ship. When polyfill missing, bundler falls back to `new Request(req)` in its helper.

nina: what's your proposed fix?

emma: short-term: change SDK retry logic to prefer req.clone() and fallback to a header-preserving reconstruction if clone throws or is absent. patch idea:
```js
function clonePreserveHeaders(req){
  if (typeof req.clone === 'function') return req.clone();
  const headers = new Headers();
  for (const [k,v] of (req.headers || [])) headers.set(k,v);
  return new Request(req.url, {method: req.method, headers, body: req.body});
}
```

emma: with that change my repro passes across vite/rollup/webpack edge builds. it does add a tiny bit of code but seems safer than trusting bundler helpers.

tanner: that seems reasonable. i'll review for edge runtime semantics (e.g., streaming body differences) and add tests that run the built bundles in our edge shim matrix. can you open an issue?

kai: opened redwood/sdk#4221 and assigned to @tanner + eng-runtime. added repro link and CI job that builds with vite/rollup/webpack in matrix.

devx-bot: Issue created: redwood/sdk#4221 
Assigned to: @tanner, @eng-runtime. CI triggered. :rocket:

nina: for docs, add a short note in the SDK "Edge bundler quirks" section: prefer `import * as SDK from 'redwood-sdk'` as a temporary mitigation because namespace imports tend to force a different interop path in Rollup/Vite currently. include the repro link and the workaround until patch ships.

emma: pushed branch `devex/edge-clone-fallback` with the patch + cross-bundler CI to the repro repo: https://example/repro-edge-auth/compare/devex/edge-clone-fallback

tanner: i'll prototype the unit tests and also check any implications for native fetch streaming in real edge platforms. if everything looks good we'll merge the patch and cut a minor release.

emma: thanks. added a short customer note for support: "If you see 403 after retries only in edge bundles, try switching import style or upgrade to SDK >= X.Y.Z once released."

kai: appreciated, team. saved a potential support escalation. :thumbsup:
